subject: Furniture around fireplaces and alcoves
hook: Your two alcoves are almost certainly different sizes.
ig:
Your two alcoves are almost certainly different sizes. Here's what to check before you plan alcove units.

Chimney breasts are rarely central and older walls are rarely straight. That's why off-the-shelf units so often leave a gap on one side.

Before you plan anything:
— measure each alcove at the top, middle and bottom
— treat left and right as two separate jobs
— note skirting, picture rails and coving
— mark sockets, switches and the aerial point
— if the fire works, find the manual for its clearance rules

Your own measurements are great for a rough plan and a first conversation. For the build, we survey everything ourselves so each alcove unit is made to its own size and scribed to the wall on fitting.

Save this before you pick up the tape measure, and tap the link in bio for a free design consultation.
